Receiver-owned capability-development need: Develop rough-transport cart designs with a method another lab published. Adopting or running the method requires a role holding method.develop
Desired acceptance: Beats the fixed cart by one success on twelve fresh public instances
An exact network method selection is retained as evidence (64037fe81d9e46f57052531b12d52e3153d55ef4ab895f64795ecbcdef8d7cfc). It is not an installed Actor capability or an accepted method. Assess continuing responsibility using the existing owners; create a specialist only when distinct continuing work justifies it. Availability alone requires no organizational change.
